uzo.purpose: Shows what happened in the order of time: every entry a date, a title and what happened, its status done, current or upcoming.

instead.kialo: Many events with the same fields that a person sorts and compares are a table, because a timeline reads them one after the other and sorts by nothing but time.

boundary.kialo: A timeline runs from top to bottom, because its entries carry text of any length and a row of them would break; a horizontal one is not supported.

containers.name: page-section
containers.kialo: The history of a thing stands in a section of its page, because the person reads it next to the thing it tells about.

containers.name: card
containers.kialo: A card may show the last steps of what it stands for, because its state is a part of it.

with.kialo: What happened may lead to where it happened, because a change has a place of its own.
A version or a kind of change beside the title is a badge, because it is one or two words.

case.de: Viele Ereignisse mit denselben Feldern sollen sortiert und verglichen werden.
case.en: Many events with the same fields are to be sorted and compared.

case.de: Die Felder eines einzelnen Datensatzes sollen als Name und Wert stehen.
case.en: The fields of a single record are to stand as name and value.

do.de: Gib jedem Eintrag ein <time> mit datetime, damit Maschinen das Datum lesen und Menschen es in ihren Worten sehen.
do.en: Give every entry a <time> with datetime, so that machines read the date and people see it in their words.

do.de: Setze data-status an jeden Eintrag; höchstens einer ist current.
do.en: Set data-status on every entry; at most one is current.

do.de: Benenne die Zeitleiste mit label, sobald eine Seite mehr als eine zeigt.
do.en: Name the timeline with label as soon as a page shows more than one.

dont.de: Den Status nur über eine eigene Farbe zeigen, denn die Form des Zeichens und das gesprochene Wort tragen ihn.
dont.en: Show the status only by a colour of your own, because the shape of the sign and the spoken word carry it.

dont.de: Die Einträge gegen die Zeit sortieren, denn die Reihenfolge der Liste ist die Reihenfolge der Zeit.
dont.en: Sort the entries against time, because the order of the list is the order of time.

none.de: Die Zeitleiste nimmt weder den Fokus noch eine Taste; Links in ihren Einträgen erreicht Tab in der Reihenfolge der Zeit.
none.en: The timeline takes neither the focus nor a key; Tab reaches the links in its entries in the order of time.
